Release notes

Cassandra replaced MySQL for the event log in March. Read latency at the ninety ninth percentile fell from three hundred and forty milliseconds to forty five, and the nightly export now finishes in eleven minutes rather than the fifty it used to take.

Jenkins builds the site on Node twenty four. The agent lacks the Sora typeface, so documents generated there came out in a fallback face, and we commit them from a local build instead of regenerating them in continuous integration.

Lead Developer, Innovation Team Astro-Vision FutureTech April 2016 to August 2017
